NF-F001.body:
<!-- nordic-work-item:NF-F001 -->

Submit bounded work from Langflow and follow saved-agent sessions and evidence without duplicate starts.

Kind: Feature · Sprint: Pilot 1 · Priority: P0
Parent: none

Acceptance:
- [ ] Three imported flows run offline
- [ ] One saved-agent planning chain completes
- [ ] One reference audit completes

- [ ] Idempotency, authorization and interruption checks pass

Planning proposal. Completion requires actual acceptance evidence.
